purpose: Révision demandée : trois bonus montés chacun sur une plaque carrée / 用户要求：三个道具分别放在方形板上

output.alpha: 0 ou 255 ; plaque opaque, extérieur transparent / 板面不透明、板外透明

export: export-sprites.swift : échantillonnage au plus proche en 64×64, alpha au seuil 0,5, palette déterministe sans tramage, agrandissement entier ×4 / 最近邻采样到64×64，透明阈值0.5，无抖动确定性减色，整倍数放大4倍

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: pixel-art power-up tile for the existing Grenoble Bomber game.
Primary request: edit the supplied pickup icon by mounting it onto ONE square wooden plaque. Preserve the existing subject, colors, dark outline and clear square-pixel technique, scaling and centering the subject to fit naturally inside the board. The result is a game collectible tile with the emblem painted or lightly raised ON the board.
BOARD DESIGN, identical across the three-item set: straight-on front-facing SQUARE plaque, no isometric angle or perspective. A warm honey-ochre wooden frame surrounding a plain light creamy parchment-colored inset face; small blocky beveled top-left highlights and darker lower-right edge. Outer dark blue-charcoal stepped outline matching the icon. Very slightly chamfered square corners, NOT rounded like a mobile app button. Four tiny dark slate square rivets at the four corners of the wooden frame. No wood grain clutter or decorative marks. Use approximately dark outline #25313d, warm wood midtone #b8753e, honey wood highlight #e0ad62, light cream face #f0dbb2. The cream face should be much lighter than the symbols so all icons read immediately.
COMPOSITION: square canvas with the board occupying exactly the same 88% width and 88% height, centered, equal transparent margins on all four sides. On a logical 64x64 grid: board bounds x=4..59, y=4..59; 2-pixel outer outline, 4-pixel wooden rim, flat inner light-cream panel. The subject fits within x=13..50, y=12..51 with a little breathing room, no part overlaps the frame or extends outside the board. The board is ONE opaque physical plate; its interior must NOT be transparent.
STYLE: genuine coarse low-resolution pixel art on a uniform 64x64 logical artwork grid, intended for integer upscaling to 256x256. Large consistently square pixels, crisp stepped edges, restrained 3-shade flat color clusters per material. Absolutely no gradients, antialiasing, soft focus, glow, photographic texture or smooth vector curves. Same handmade retro pixel-game style as the input icon. No lighting or drop shadow outside the board.
Background: actual transparent alpha ONLY OUTSIDE the complete board silhouette. No background scene, no extra props, no text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark. Exactly ONE complete board with ONE emblem, not a row or a sprite sheet.

Emblem: preserve the navy round bomb with ochre fuse, small amber spark and prominent mint-green PLUS sign. The bomb and plus must both be clearly legible. Scale the entire emblem down as a unit to fit fully within the board's cream inset panel.
